projectDescription: Strails is a stablecoin orchestration and orderbook engine that enables Nigerian fintechs to integrate cNGN, USDC, and USDT stablecoin on/off-ramp, P2P FX trading, multi-chain wallets, and NGN bank transfers via a single REST API.
keyFeatures: NGN onramp and offramp via Nigerian virtual bank accounts with automatic cNGN minting
P2P FX orderbook for cNGN ↔ USDC/USDT trading between fintechs
Multi-chain wallet infrastructure (Smart Wallet, MPC Vault, HSM-managed wallet) across Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, and Bantu
Auto-swap: automatic conversion of NGN → cNGN → USDC/USDT in a single deposit flow
Real-time webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for 22 event types
BVN-based user onboarding with permanent and temporary virtual account generation
Configurable fintech fee structures for onramp and offramp operations
Ed25519 payload encryption for sensitive data protection
IP allowlisting and API key management for enterprise security
publicApiSurface: POST /onboarduser — onboard a user with BVN verification
POST /onboardstatus — check user onboarding status
POST /getuserdetails — retrieve user details including wallets and virtual accounts
POST /cngnonramp — initiate fiat-to-cNGN wallet funding
POST /cngnofframp — initiate cNGN-to-fiat payout to user bank account
POST /getvirtualaccount — retrieve temporary virtual account for a funding request
GET /getfintechvirtualaccount — retrieve fintech permanent virtual account
GET /getfintechwallet — retrieve fintech smart/MPC/external wallet info
POST /withdrawasset — withdraw tokens from user wallet to external wallet
POST /fintechtransfer — transfer tokens from fintech smart wallet
POST /swap — swap tokens on user smart wallet
POST /swaptrigger — trigger asynchronous token swap
POST /fx/orders — create FX limit order on orderbook
GET /fx/orderbook — view public orderbook
POST /fx/quote — get FX trade quote
POST /fx/trade — execute FX trade
POST /fx/market-order — execute immediate market order
POST /fx/mpc/register — register MPC vault for FX settlement
PUT /managefees — configure onramp/offramp fee structure
POST /setwebhook — configure webhook URL and secret
POST /manageipallowlist — manage IP allowlist
GET /transactions — list all transactions with filters
GET /deposits — list deposit transactions
GET /payouts — list payout transactions
